metadata.distribution: 35% of orders belong to five whale accounts per tenant; remaining orders are uniform; four lines/order

method: Service Risk only; direct executors; six variants, same process/database, two warmups each, twelve sequential samples each with rotated/reversed order, first/last-tenant parity. All variants use existing public APIs; no library feature changes. Bundled parallel variants trade independent field pruning for manual concurrency. No HTTP timing or concurrency-4 measurement.
limitations: Experimental narrower risk resource; not a replacement for all AccountResource capabilities or a generic optimizer.
JavaScript experiment; public output schemas and runtime policies are enforced, but this is not a TypeScript inference test.
Bulk variants normalize original foreign array keys and keep exact managed-count policies/filters. Revenue and exposure preserve the demo's existing raw business matches.
Different batch sizes and bundled inputs change execution granularity; repeated independent field work under other selections is not measured.
Twelve local samples are exploratory; driver times overlap in parallel variants and cannot be summed as request wall time.
